# The protocol-selector landing gates manual entry but leaves continuation routing for a later phase

This landing adds a native radio form that maps Exchange-family configuration types to microsoft and returns the checked protocol value. Preference-enabled manual entry can show it, while config-found editing stays on the existing protocol form. The original continuation stores incoming.type and leaves routing as TODO; current accepted initManualConfig routing is a later phase. The new tests directly check entry/radio/Fluent/notification state with 18 nonempty should assertion messages and leave next-subview checks pending. Card extraction, provider configuration, username-only clearing and full navigation are not established. Required primary numbered comment 3 remains absent with unknown author/type; zero full-audit credit.

Scope: Account Hub manual protocol selection.
